first-galactic-war.title: First Galactic War
first-galactic-war.description: The First Galactic War was a roughly forty-year conflict fought by the Super Earth Federation against the Bugs, Cyborgs, and Illuminate. The Helldivers fought across all three fronts, and the war ultimately ended in Super Earth victory. The Bugs were placed into farms for Element 710 production, the defeated Cyborgs were forced to labor on Cyberstan, and the Illuminate were defeated and believed to have been eradicated.

second-galactic-war.title: Second Galactic War
second-galactic-war.description: The Second Galactic War began around 2184 after approximately a century of relative peace following the First Galactic War. Terminids escaped containment and spread through the eastern sectors while the Automaton Legion emerged in the west, prompting Super Earth to reactivate the Helldivers. The conflict later expanded further with the return of the Illuminate, creating a galaxy-wide war fought across multiple fronts.

operation-valiant-enclosure.title: Operation Valiant Enclosure
operation-valiant-enclosure.description: Operation Valiant Enclosure was a major Super Earth campaign against the Terminids during the early Second Galactic War. Helldivers fought to secure the Barrier Planets of Erata Prime, Fenrir III, Meridia, and Turing, where the Terminid Control System was constructed and activated. The TCS dispersed Termicide in an attempt to contain the Terminid threat. Although initially declared a success, some Terminids adapted to the chemical, contributing to explosive reproduction and the eventual transformation of Meridia into a Supercolony.

operation-swift-disassembly.title: Operation Swift Disassembly
operation-swift-disassembly.description: Operation Swift Disassembly was a multi-phase Super Earth offensive intended to completely eradicate the Automatons. Helldivers captured a long-range communications array on Troost, attacked Automaton production centers, defended key worlds against a counterattack, and finally assaulted the remaining Automaton planets of Maia, Tibit, and Durgen. The operation appeared successful when the Automaton vanguard was eliminated, but the victory was short-lived: a much larger Automaton fleet soon invaded during the Reclamation.

the-reclamation.title: The Reclamation
the-reclamation.description: The Reclamation began on April 9, 2184, only two days after Super Earth believed the Automatons had been eradicated. A massive Automaton invasion fleet arrived from beyond the Galactic Frontier and overwhelmed Super Earth defenses across the Valdis region. The invading force dwarfed the Automaton vanguard destroyed during Operation Swift Disassembly and rapidly captured Cyberstan, revealing that the earlier Automaton armies had represented only a fraction of their true strength.

operation-enduring-peace.title: Operation Enduring Peace
operation-enduring-peace.description: Operation Enduring Peace was Super Earth's campaign to destroy the Terminid Supercolony on Meridia. Helldivers first secured the surrounding staging worlds before deploying weaponized Dark Fluid into Meridia's crust. Once enough Dark Fluid had been injected, the planet collapsed, destroying the Supercolony and leaving the Meridian Black Hole in its place.

battle-of-calypso.title: Battle of Calypso
battle-of-calypso.description: The Battle of Calypso marked the return of the Illuminate to open warfare after more than a century. Illuminate forces emerged through the Meridian anomaly and launched a surprise invasion of the Super Earth colony on Calypso. The attackers deployed Overseers, Harvesters, and hordes of Voteless created from abducted and transformed human colonists. Helldivers were ordered to Calypso under LIBCON 1 and fought for roughly three days before successfully repelling the invasion.

the-great-host.title: The Great Host
the-great-host.description: The Great Host was a massive Illuminate invasion fleet constructed in secret beyond the Meridian Wormhole. After the Meridian Singularity was halted, the fleet emerged and began advancing toward Super Earth, bringing new Illuminate forces including Stingrays, Fleshmobs, Crescent Overseers, Leviathans, and Overships. The Great Host eventually reached the Solar System and launched the Illuminate assault on Super Earth before being destroyed during the Battle for Super Earth.

battle-for-super-earth.title: First Battle for Super Earth
battle-for-super-earth.description: The First Battle for Super Earth began on May 20, 2185 when the Illuminate Great Host reached humanity's homeworld and assaulted its Mega Cities. Helldivers and SEAF forces fought an eleven-day defense as Eagleopolis, Remembrance, Administrative Center 02, Port Mercy, and York Supreme were destroyed. Despite enormous losses and the death of the President of Super Earth, the defenders reduced the Great Host to a fraction of its original strength. On the final day, the Illuminate withdrew, leaving Prosperity City and Equality-on-Sea standing and Super Earth under Federation control.

great-host-remnants.title: Remnants of the Great Host
great-host-remnants.description: After their defeat during the First Battle for Super Earth, the surviving Illuminate forces activated cloaking technology and withdrew from the homeworld. Super Earth scientists later studied captured Illuminate wreckage and developed methods to detect the cloaked enemy. Hidden Illuminate positions were subsequently discovered in the southern galaxy, proving that the defeat of the Great Host had not ended the Illuminate threat.

operation-righteous-reclamation.title: Operation Righteous Reclamation
operation-righteous-reclamation.description: Operation Righteous Reclamation was Super Earth's major offensive into the Gloom. Beginning in August 2185, Helldivers were ordered to penetrate the massive Terminid spore cloud and establish a permanent forward operating base within its perimeter. Hellmire was liberated and Outpost Alpha was established, giving the Helldiver fleet unprecedented access to the interior of the Gloom. From there, spore-flow analysis led Super Earth to Oshaune, a planet transformed by extreme Terminid terraformation into a Hive World. The operation then expanded into reconnaissance, research, and combat operations against the mutated Terminids hidden within the Gloom.
